configure_logger_output_file: configure the Logger to write tabular diagnostic data to a specified output file path
log_tabular_key_value: log a key-value diagnostic pair to the Logger for the current iteration
print_tabular_diagnostics: print all logged diagnostic key-value pairs from the current iteration to stdout
dump_tabular_to_file: write all logged diagnostic key-value pairs from the current iteration to the output file
reset_logger_state: reset the Logger state by clearing headers, current row data, and reopening the output file
